text: Back to Lesson 1's actual ask: a revenue number Finance trusts, by day, by payment method, that doesn't move unexpectedly. That sentence specifies this page almost completely.

Total Revenue is sum of fct_orders amount. No unit conversion needed here — amount already arrived in dollars, because that conversion happened once, in the staging layer, back in Lesson 7. Revenue MTD wraps it in a real DATESMTD time-intelligence pattern.

Two visuals together answer the full ask: revenue over time, with order_date on the axis, and revenue by payment method, using the payment_method column that reached fct_orders through Lesson 6's payments join.

Before trusting this page, compare Total Revenue with no filters against a plain sum of amount run directly in Snowflake against fct_orders. They have to match exactly. If they don't, the problem is upstream in the model, not in this DAX.
Next lesson: building the Ops order-status page — counts by status, the other half of this chapter's two stakeholders.
